description: Search USGS stream gauges nationwide by river and place name (for example "mississippi st louis", "potomac little falls"), by state, or within a radius of a latitude and longitude. Returns site numbers with whether each is reporting now and its latest stage and flow, active gauges first.

latitude.description: Latitude for a nearby search, for example 38.63.

longitude.description: Longitude for a nearby search, for example -90.18.

query.description: Words from the gauge name: river plus town, for example "colorado river austin". Words like river, at and near are ignored.

radius_miles.description: Radius for a latitude and longitude search, 1 to 100 miles. Default 15.

state.description: Two-letter state code (MO) or full state name (Missouri).

name: find_river_gauges
title: Find river gauges
